captions.text: The blast shook the basement, but I was alive.
Then my phone buzzed in the dark.
A notification from ME, twenty-four hours from now.
Do not drink the mall water.
I looked up. Glowing black spores were pouring from the vents.
They did not drop a bomb. They opened a rift.
From the emergency stairwell, heavy metallic footsteps echoed.
The blast doors did not seal them out.
They locked you in with them.
